text:
maya: quick check — my PR touching /v1/generate structured output changed the optional `source` field behavior. should we return `null`, empty string, or omit when unknown?

maya: current code does `
```json
{"id":"abc","source":""}
```
and the jsonschema we ship has `type: ["string", "null"]` for source. wondering about client compat and sdk handling.

kevin: my vote: prefer omit for absent optional scalars. saves downstream checks. but older clients might expect the key always present.

olivia: SDK note — JS SDK treats `undefined` (absent) differently than `null`. a lot of users check `if (resp.source)` which treats both empty string and null as falsy, but `in` operator behaves differently. we should pick one to reduce surprises.

kevin: +1 to omit. if we keep `null`, we need to document and update SDKs.

sam: who will update contract tests? we have a contract runner that compares example responses to schema. we should add an integration that enforces "no empty-string unless explicitly allowed".

maya: I can add unit tests on the server side and a contract test in the PR. question: do we also need to change the OpenAPI schema or just the internal jsonschema?

olivia: update OpenAPI too. generate the SDK after schema change. add a changelog note so customers know nil semantics changed.

schema-bot: lint report: 2 occurrences of \"source\": \"\" in examples. recommended: remove example keys or set to `null` based on new guideline — https://ci.internal/runs/8792

kevin: decision proposal: For optional string fields: prefer omitted when unknown. If present, allow non-empty string. Disallow empty string in schema (unless field explicitly `allowEmpty: true`). Update jsonschema to remove `\"\"` examples and set `type: \"string\"` (no null). Add migration note and bump minor version.

olivia: also think about streaming/ndjson endpoints — they may emit partial objects. recommend emitting object without the field rather than `\"field\": null` to keep event sizes smaller.

sam: I'll queue a canary run after the schema + SDK are updated. target canary: next deploy window (tomorrow morning).

maya: thanks. I'll: 1) update OpenAPI + jsonschema 2) remove empty-string examples 3) add unit + contract tests 4) add changelog note. pinging @kevin for review once PR is up.

kevin: will review, please add a short rationale in the PR description so support can reference it. :thumbsup:

olivia: also add a one-liner in the dev docs (response-format section) so product folks can find it.

maya: noted. PR will reference the schema-bot link and the canary run plan.

sam: tagging this as resolved for coordination — followup to check SDK customers after canary.

maya: thanks everyone :)
